sentences.text: Daniel Thomas `` Dan '' O'Bannon -LRB- September 30 , 1946 -- December 17 , 2009 -RRB- was an American film screenwriter , director , visual effects supervisor , and occasional actor , usually in the science fiction and horror genres .	screenwriter	screenwriter	director	film director	visual effects supervisor	visual effects supervisor	science fiction	science fiction	horror	Horror fiction
O'Bannon is best known for having written the screenplay for Alien , adapted from a story he wrote with Ronald Shusett .	Alien	Alien (film)	Ronald Shusett	Ronald Shusett

He also contributed computer animation to Star Wars , worked on cult classics such as Dark Star , Heavy Metal and Total Recall , and both wrote and directed the horror comedy The Return of the Living Dead .	horror	Horror fiction	Star Wars	Star Wars (film)	Dark Star	Dark Star (film)	Heavy Metal	Heavy Metal (film)	Total Recall	Total Recall (1990 film)	The Return of the Living Dead	The Return of the Living Dead
